verdict.rationale: Publishing a robots.txt is a fair question for any public web service, so the axis applies. The only probe of a robots.txt on the agency's hosts found that wyobiz.wyo.gov answers 200 with an HTML document carrying no machine-readable rules, which is not a real robots.txt. Nothing in the evidence shows a valid robots.txt on sos.wyo.gov, so there is no support for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
